name: Brise-Glace
intro: Brise-Glace (French for "ice-breaker") was a 1990s instrumental avant-rock "supergroup" composed of Jim O'Rourke (guitar, organ, tape and "razor blade"), Darin Gray (bass guitar), Dylan Posa (guitar), and Thymme Jones (drums).

edges.label: Darin Gray・Thymme Jones
edges.detail: 2 位乐手在这两支乐队都待过：Darin Gray・Thymme Jones。
